Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
8:15 AM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 chip.

Memory: 16 GB is the minimum. Make sure it can be upgraded later if you run Docker or several projects at once.
Processor: A recent Ryzen 5/7 or Core i5/i7 keeps builds quick. Skip a graphics card unless you do machine learning or games.
Screen and keyboard: Pick a bright 1080p screen (IPS or better) and a keyboard you like typing on for hours.
Battery and weight: If you carry it daily, look for around 1.5 kg and a battery that lasts a full workday.
